thread:
eli_support: Heads-up—we just had a priority P1 from Acme: they saw intermittent 401s and duplicate billing after updating to latest TS/Python clients. Happened after yesterday's OpenAPI push. Full repro steps below. Can we triage?

alex_eng: Ack. Can you paste the request/response and SDK versions?

eli_support: SDKs: python 2.4.0 (regen today), ts-sdk 3.1.0-beta (auto-regen). Request log:```POST /v1/embeddings 200ms
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Response: 401 {"error":"invalid_client"} then 200 on retry
Client retried once and invoice shows 2 tokens billed```

maria_devex: interesting — sounds like client-side retry + auth header behavior changed. Did spec rename the header param in the OpenAPI? It should still be `Authorization`.

jordan_sre: I ran a quick bisect of the codegen pipeline; the generator template for auth got an accidental `if` that wraps header in `authorization` lowercased for TS only in commit abc123. That would cause some proxies to treat header differently. Filing PR to revert.

alex_eng: Also check retry logic — older SDKs used idempotency checks (no charge if last request succeeded). New generator added unconditional retry on 401 which caused double-charge. Patch suggestion in #repo: add status code guard to only retry on 5xx and network errors.

ben_platform: FYI deploy-bot rolled the spec at 2026-03-16T22:11Z. @maria_devex can we add a CI gate to run a smoke auth test across SDKs when spec changes?

maria_devex: yes — adding a lightweight smoke test to regen CI: `make smoke-sdk-tests` that calls `/v1/auth/check` with a test token. Will block merges on auth regressions. PR coming.

eli_support: For the customer, recommended mitigation: pin SDK to pre-regeneration release and request a billing refund. I've asked billing to hold charges. Can someone post the revert PR and cherry-pick to the 2.4.x branch?

alex_eng: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/regen/commit/def456
Patch summary: revert template change + add retry guard. I will cherry-pick to release/2.4 and trigger a regen CI with pinned generator. Will also add changelog entry.

maria_devex: note for changelog: explain OpenAPI field casing change caused header mismatch in some infra. Add "CI: added smoke auth test" line.

eli_support: thanks. Customer is on standby for a patch ETA — please update thread when deployed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: release/2.4.1 -> prod (initiated by alex_eng)

jordan_sre: monitoring traces for duplicate billing spikes — will report if any anomalies.

eli_support: Closing loop: customer confirmed revert solved 401s. Billing will confirm refunds tomorrow. Great work team!
